propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single scalar that cannot express per-tier model configuration and must be deprecated in favor of per-class environment variables and config table slots
the deprecation is scheduled for removal at v1.0.0 via _scheduled() registration in _deprecations.REGISTRY with permanent=False, not kept as a permanent alias
within the migration window REBAR_LLM_MODEL maps to all three classes (FRONTIER, PLAN, CRITIC) with widest-compatibility semantics and emits a warning at every env read
warn_deprecated must be called at both env-read sites: config.py:469 (config.from_env path) and model_classes.py (fan-out path), because a single call site misses one code path
when REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set with no explicit class configuration, all three classes resolve to that model value; when explicit class config exists, it takes precedence
the deprecation warning is emitted per call without once-per-process dedup, and fires even when CLI flags override the env var, warning operators to migrate their configuration
